siteMetadata.title: Joseph Crawford
siteMetadata.description: Software engineering, AI tools, and homebrewing — written by Joseph Crawford, a developer building web applications and making mead in Vermont.

frontmatter.title: Caramel-Apple Bochet
frontmatter.excerpt: A layered 1-gallon bochet that starts with a clean traditional primary, adds caramelized honey for a second stage of primary, then finishes with oven-baked apples and reserved caramel honey for backsweetening after pasteurization. This batch finished at about half a gallon — see the yield note.

frontmatter.title: Cherry Mead
frontmatter.excerpt: A sweet cherry melomel recipe using wildflower honey, frozen cherries in a mesh bag, and Red Star Premier Blanc yeast with double fruit addition for flavor.

frontmatter.title: Strawberry Wine
frontmatter.excerpt: A fresh strawberry wine recipe using pureed fruit, a Camden tablet to kill wild yeast, and Red Star Cote Des Blancs. One-gallon batch ages a year at 11.3% ABV.
